sourceDocument.rawExtractedText:
DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION
Federal Aviation Administration
14 CFR Part 39 [Docket No. FAA-2020-0686; Product Identifier 2020-NM-084-AD; Amendment 39-21335; AD 2020-24-02]
RIN 2120-AA64
Airworthiness Directives; The Boeing Company Airplanes
AGENCY: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), DOT.
ACTION: Final rule.
SUMMARY: The FAA is superseding Airworthiness Directive (AD) 2018-23-51, which applied to all The Boeing Company Model 737-8 and 737-9 airplanes. This AD requires installing new flight control computer (FCC) software, revising the existing AFM, installing new MAX display system (MDS) software, changing the horizontal stabilizer trim wire routing installations, completing an AOA sensor system test, and performing an operational readiness flight.
DATES: This AD is effective January 15, 2021.

(c) Applicability
This AD applies to all The Boeing Company Model 737-8 and 737-9 airplanes, certificated in any category.

(g) Required Actions
(1) Flight Control Computer (FCC) Software Installation:
Before further flight after the effective date of this AD, install FCC software version P12.1.2 (P/N 2274-COL-AC2-26) or later approved version on FCC A and FCC B, in accordance with the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Requirements Bulletin 737-22A1011 RB, dated November 17, 2020.
(2) MAX Display System (MDS) Software Installation:
Before further flight after the effective date of this AD, install MDS software version 12.0 (P/N 285W0053-12000) or later approved version, in accordance with Boeing Alert Requirements Bulletin 737-31A1032 RB, dated November 17, 2020.
(3) Airplane Flight Manual (AFM) Revision:
Before further flight after the effective date of this AD, revise the existing AFM to incorporate the flightcrew procedures specified in Boeing Document D631A001-N7378.
(4) Horizontal Stabilizer Trim Wire Routing Modification:
Before further flight after the effective date of this AD, modify the horizontal stabilizer trim wire routing installations in accordance with Boeing Alert Requirements Bulletin 737-24A1202 RB, dated November 17, 2020.
(5) AOA Sensor System Test:
Before further flight after the effective date of this AD, perform an AOA sensor system test in accordance with Boeing Alert Requirements Bulletin 737-34A1325 RB, dated November 17, 2020.
(6) Operational Readiness Flight:
Before returning the airplane to revenue service following accomplishment of paragraphs (g)(1) through (g)(5) of this AD, perform an operational readiness flight in accordance with procedures approved by the FAA.

(h) Effectivity and Service Information
Refer to Boeing Alert Requirements Bulletin 737-22A1011 RB for affected serial numbers and airplane groups.
